worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.summary: Writes the most recent damage into a grudge, then sends a shadow to hunt the debtor after a beat, returning 1.5x; with an empty ledger the mark disperses.
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.use.0: Hunt a distant foe after taking a hit
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.use.1: Punish a ranged attacker that struck first
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.use.2: Turn damage taken into a delayed heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.descriptio: Sends the %1$s point refund recorded on the user out with the shadow; only damage taken within the last %2$s becomes that grudge, physical or special alike.
Hunt range %1$s blocks, shadow at %2$s blocks per tick, released %3$s s after the mark, collision radius %4$s blocks. The refund never exceeds %5$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.grudge.on: Grudge mode on: the ledger window is 2 s longer and the stalk delay 0.5 s longer, so a much older debt can be pursued, but prepare takes 2 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks more.
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.grudge.off: Grudge mode off: hunts sooner and only the freshest debt counts.
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.growth.0: At level %1$s the refund cap rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.growth.1: At level %1$s the refund cap rises to %2$s and the hunt range extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.comeuppance.preference: On: the ledger window is 2 s longer and the stalk delay 0.5 s longer, so the shadow can pursue a much older debt, but prepare takes 2 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks more. Off: hunts sooner and only the freshest debt counts.
Only send the shadow at the debtor within this distance; a larger value commits the hunt from farther away.
